mandatory_legal_checks: Civil Procedure Code 1908 S.80(1) — where the addressee is the Government or a public officer sued for an official act, NO SUIT for two months after notice; the compliance period must be at least that
Civil Procedure Code 1908 S.80(3) — the notice must state the sender's name, description and residence, the cause of action and the relief claimed
Limitation Act 1963 Articles 19 and 55 — three years; a notice does not stop limitation running
Limitation Act 1963 S.18 — a written acknowledgement signed before expiry starts a fresh period; do not inadvertently make one for the other side
General Clauses Act 1897 S.27 — service by registered post is presumed; send by that route to keep the presumption
A threat of criminal proceedings where the dispute is purely civil is improper — delete unless the facts disclose an offence
